sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Now, we've been asked to choose an aspect of European clothing or fashion and to talk about its development over time.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们被要求选择欧洲服装或时尚的一个方面，并谈谈它随时间的发展。

sentences.en: decided to focus on a rather small area of clothing and that's pockets.
sentences.zh: 决定专注于服装中一个相当小的领域，即口袋。

sentences.en: I chose pockets for two reasons, really.
sentences.zh: 我选择口袋主要有两个原因。

sentences.en: We all have them - in jeans, jackets, coats, for example - and even though we often carry bags or briefcases as well, nothing is quite as convenient as being able to pop your phone or credit card into your pocket.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都有口袋——例如牛仔裤、夹克、大衣上都有——尽管我们通常还会携带包或公文包，但没有什么比把手机或信用卡随手塞进口袋里更方便了。

sentences.en: Yet, I suspect that, other than that, people don't really think about pockets too much and they're rather overlooked as a fashion item.
sentences.zh: 然而，我怀疑除了这一点之外，人们其实很少真正思考口袋，而且它作为时尚单品往往被忽视。

sentences.en: It's certainly very interesting to go back in time and see how pockets developed for men and women.
sentences.zh: 回溯历史，观察口袋在男性和女性身上的发展历程，确实非常有趣。

sentences.en: In the 18th century, fashions were quite different from the way they are now, and pockets were too.
sentences.zh: 18世纪的时尚与当今大不相同，口袋也是如此。

sentences.en: If we think about male fashion first ... that was the time when suits became popular.
sentences.zh: 如果我们先考虑男性时尚……那正是西装开始流行的时期。

sentences.en: Trousers were knee-length only and referred to as 'breeches', the waistcoats were short and the jackets were long, but all three garments were lined with material and pockets were sewn into this cloth by whichever tailor the customer used.
sentences.zh: 裤子仅及膝盖长度，被称为‘马裤’；背心较短，外套较长；但这三件衣物均以布料衬里，而口袋则由顾客所雇用的裁缝缝制在衬里布料中。

sentences.en: The wearer could then carry small objects such as pencils or coins on their person and reach them through a gap in a the lining.
sentences.zh: 穿着者便可将铅笔或硬币等小物件随身携带，并通过衬里上的开口取用。

sentences.en: Coat pockets became increasingly decorative on the outside for men who wanted to look stylish, but they were often larger but plainer if the wearer was someone with a profession who needed to carry medical instruments - a doctor or physician, for example.
sentences.zh: 对于希望显得时髦的男性而言，外套外侧的口袋日益变得装饰性更强；但对于需要随身携带医疗器械（例如医生或内科医师）的职业人士来说，其口袋往往更大但更朴素。

sentences.en: The development of women's pockets was a little different.
sentences.zh: 女性口袋的发展则略有不同。

sentences.en: For one a thing, they weren't nearly as visible or as easy to reach as men's.
sentences.zh: 首先，它们远不如男性的口袋显眼，也不易触及。

sentences.en: In the 18th and 19th centuries, women carried numerous possessions on their person and some of these could be worth a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 在18至19世纪，女性随身携带大量物品，其中一些价值不菲。

sentences.en: Women were more vulnerable to theft and wealthy women, in particular, worried constantly about pickpockets.
sentences.zh: 女性更容易遭遇盗窃，尤其是富裕女性，始终担忧扒手。

sentences.en: So - what they did was to have a pair of pockets made that were tied together with string.
sentences.zh: 因此，她们的做法是制作一对用绳子系在一起的口袋。

sentences.en: The pockets were made of fabric, which might be recycled cloth if the wearer had little money or something more expensive, such as linen, sometimes featuring very delicate embroidery.
sentences.zh: 这些口袋由布料制成：若佩戴者经济拮据，可能使用回收布料；若较富裕，则可能选用亚麻等更昂贵的材质，有时还饰有极其精致的刺绣。

sentences.en: Women tied the pockets around their waist so that they hung beneath their clothes.
sentences.zh: 女性将口袋系于腰间，使其垂于衣物之下。

sentences.en: Remember, skirts were long then and there was plenty of room to hide a whole range of small possessions between the layers of petticoats that were commonly worn.
sentences.zh: 请记住，当时裙子很长，且普遍穿着多层衬裙，其间有足够的空间隐藏各种小物件。

sentences.en: They would have an opening in the folds of their skirts through which they could reach.
sentences.zh: 她们在裙子褶皱处留有开口，以便伸手取物。

sentences.en: whatever they needed, like their perfume.
sentences.zh: 比如她们的香水。

sentences.en: Working women, of course, also needed to carry around items that they might use for whatever job or trade they were involved in, but their pairs of pockets still remained on the inside of their clothing, they just got bigger or longer - sometimes reaching down to their knees!
sentences.zh: 当然，职业女性也需要随身携带工作或行业所需的各种物品，但她们的成对口袋仍保留在衣物内侧，只是尺寸变大或加长——有时甚至延伸至膝盖！

sentences.en: So the tie-on pockets went well into the 19th century and only changed when fashion altered towards the end of that period.
sentences.zh: 因此，系带式口袋一直沿用至19世纪，并仅在该世纪末因时尚风格转变才发生变化。

sentences.en: That's when dresses became tighter and less bulky. and the pairs of pockets became very noticeable - they stood out too much and detracted from the woman's image.
sentences.zh: 那时连衣裙变得更贴身、体积更小，成对口袋因而变得十分明显——过于突出，损害了女性的整体形象。

sentences.en: Women who had been used to carrying around a range of personal possessions - and still wanted to - needed somewhere to carry these items about their person.
sentences.zh: 那些习惯随身携带多种私人物品、且仍希望如此做的女性，需要一个新的地方来随身携带这些物品。

sentences.en: That was when small bags, or pouches as they were known, came into fashion and, of course, they inevitably led on to the handbag of more modern times, particularly when fashion removed pockets altogether.
sentences.zh: 于是，小型手袋（当时称为‘钱袋’）开始流行；当然，它们自然演变为更现代的手提包，尤其当时尚彻底取消口袋之后。
